admin0RelationOverride.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories are in scope. The French Southern and Antarctic Lands (TF) are a French overseas territory, not a sovereign state. In OpenStreetMap the only relation carrying ISO3166-1=TF is relation 2186658 (boundary=administrative, admin_level 3, ISO3166-2=FR-TF, 17 member ways, all present in the pinned OpenStreetMap France merge/france_taaf mirror of 2026-10-13; the oceania/france_taaf file lacks 5 of them), so the default admin-0 rule (admin_level=2) finds none. Game venue map only: no claims about real operations, borders or sovereignty; OSM mapped boundary, not legal-border authority. Every other proof (member ways, area assembly, segment match) still applies.

tags.note: Formal part of the French Southern and Antarctic Lands as one of its administrative districts which, like all other Antarctic claims, is inactive under the Antarctic treaty and not currently administered by France so should not have admin unit tagging

nonBoundaryRelationMembers.reason: Relation 3810329 (Terre Adélie / Adélie Land, Q184319) is the French Antarctic claim, listed by relation 2186658 with role claim. It is boundary=region without admin_level and without any ISO3166-1 tag; its own note says the claim is inactive under the Antarctic Treaty and not administered. It is not part of the territory's ring: the 17 boundary ways of 2186658 assemble the islands. The claim relation is absent from the pinned OpenStreetMap France merge/france_taaf mirror of 2026-10-13; version 13 (2026-07-27T20:44:20Z) and the tags were read from the OSM API on 2026-10-14. Antarctica is covered by the separate aq entry (Antarctic Treaty area).
